title: the self project's contract moves into its registry entry, now that every reader reads both places
acceptance: Why. T-050 (merged 2026-10-03) was split on the captain's card D-firstmate-workflow-T050-3: it shipped shell and Python readers that accept the self contract at the top level or at projects.firstmate-workflow.project, and left config.yaml unchanged, because moving the contract in the same change left no gate run able to verify it. Main now reads both locations, so the move itself is a plain change.

Move the top-level `project:` block of config.yaml unchanged to projects.firstmate-workflow.project and delete the top-level block in the same commit; exactly one self contract source remains. Old pins keep reading the location at their recorded commit without repinning. README and design section 6 say where the self contract lives.

Tests: session start/status, gate 5 and fm-failfirst read the moved contract; a config with both locations is refused. Evidence is the required GitHub check and the six gates. Workers do not run the suites.
